reviews.comment: Extremely easy class if you just get the work done. Every week can be cranked out over the weekend pretty easily. There are no exams, just online unmoderated quizzes in Canvas and a bunch of other assignments. The class works on a project which is basically to fully flesh out a plan to implement a machine learning model.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The course was asynchronous, so communication was complicated. It is a 20% deduction for late work, so turning in assignments on time is important. The class consists of one writing assignment due each Sunday and an extra credit assignment at the end of the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor, caring and knowledgeable. 5 quizzes worth ~14% each. Three case studies; one of those being a group presentation with your assigned group and a group case write-up and two individual case write-ups. Small percentage of grade based on peer evaluation and prof evaluation. Overall, Prof. Zhou made this class enjoyable and fair.
